description: Get Stock Transaction Report. Part of the Transaction Report APIs in Giddh. Requires Auth-Key or Session-Id.

count.description: Page size (number of items returned). Default: 50.

sortBy.description: Field name to sort by. Default: entry_date.

sort.description: Sort direction. Allowed values: asc, desc. Default: desc.

branchUniqueName.description: Branch uniqueName; omit for default company branch behaviour.

param.description: Param. Allowed values: CLOSING_QTY, QTY_CR, QTY_DR, RATE, AMT_CR, AMT_DR.

voucherTypes.description: Array of voucher types values. Allowed values: PURCHASE, PURCHASE_DEBIT_NOTE, PURCHASE_CREDIT_NOTE, SALES, SALES_DEBIT_NOTE, SALES_CREDIT_NOTE, MANUFACTURED, RAW_MATERIAL, RECEIPT_NOTE, DELIVERY_NOTE, CREDIT_NOTE, DEBIT_NOTE, JOURNAL.

branchUniqueNames.description: Array of branch unique names values.

warehouseUniqueNames.description: Array of warehouse unique names values.

variantUniqueNames.description: Array of variant unique names values.

batchUniqueNames.description: Array of batch unique names values.

stockUniqueNames.description: Array of stock unique names values.

stockGroupUniqueNames.description: Array of stock group unique names values.

inventoryType.description: Inventory type. Allowed values: PRODUCT, SERVICE, FIXED_ASSETS.

archived.description: When true, applies the archived filter or flag.
